senses.gloss: लिख् (I) vt. 6P (pres. लिखति) 1. To scratch, to scrape, to tear up, मूर्ध्ना दिवमिवालिखत् Bt.xv.22; 2. to draw a line, to make a mark, to write, to write down, to inscribe, संचिंत्य गीतिक्षममर्थबंधं दिवौकसस्त्वच्चरितं लिखंति Sak.vii.; 3. to draw, to sketch, to portray, to paint, मत्सादृश्यं विरहतनु वा भावगम्यं लिखंती Megh.ii.22, पाणौ खड्गलेखां लिलेख K.Pr.x.; 4. to touch; 5. to make smooth; 6. to unite sexually with a female.With आ-, 1. to scratch; 2. to write; 3. to paint, त्वामालिख्य प्रणयकुपितां धातुरागैः शिलायाम् Megh.ii.42, R.xix.19.With उद्-, 1. to scratch, to scrape; 2. to carve; 3. to polish, त्वष्ट्रेव यत्नोल्लिखितो विभाति R.vi.32;.With प्रति-, to write in return, to reply.With वि-, 1. to scratch, to scrape, पादेन हैमं विलिलेख पीठम् R.vi.15, वेदिप्रांतात्खुरविलिखितात् Sak.iv., K.S.ii.23; 2. to write; 3. to paint, to draw, to delineate, विलिखति रहसि कुरंगमदेन भवंतमसमशरभूतम् Git.G.iv.; 4. to implant, to infix.
लिख् (II) vt. 1P (pres. लिंखति) To go, to move.
लिखन n. 1. Scratching; 2. writing, inscribing; 3. a manuscript, a written document.
लिखित (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Scratched, scraped; 2. written; 3. painted, (pp. of लिख् q.v.).
लिखित (II) m. Name of a writer on law.
लिखित (III) n. 1. A document; 2. a composition.
लिखित (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Scratched, scraped; 2. written; 3. painted, (pp. of लिख् q.v.).
